cases.name: Nancy Jean Barnard
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She attended school in Lancaster, PA. and moved to St. Augustine FL in 1977. She married the love of her life, Kenneth Barnard in 1988. She loved playing and watching golf and enjoyed traveling. She worked for Jon Sundeman CPA as an accountant for many years. She was a member of Memorial Lutheran Church where she served as Treasurer for 17 years."
cases.narrative: She reportedly had severe wounds on her face when she was found by emergency responders. Responders found her violently beaten, unconscious, and not breathing. She was pronounced dead at the scene.
